title: timeline
description: A track between stops that fills. `progress` says how far the fill has gone (0 to 1) and each stop lights up as the fill passes it; `current` emphasises one stop. It also works as the progress connector between two parts of a story. Set `progress` and `current` per step with `advance` or `set` on the slide.

stops.description: The stops along the track, at least 2. They are evenly spaced unless a stop sets `at`. `label` and `sub` are inline Markdown and wrap under the stop. `id` names a stop for `current`; it defaults to the stop's index as a string, and ids must be unique.

sub.description: An optional second line under the label, inline Markdown.

at.description: Where the stop sits on the track, 0 to 1. Defaults to the stop's even position (index / (stops - 1)); the values must increase from stop to stop.

progress.description: How far the fill has gone, as a position on the track from 0 to 1, the same scale as a stop's `at`. With evenly spaced stops 0 is the first stop and 1 the last; when stops set `at`, compare `progress` with their `at` instead. A stop is lit once `progress >= at`. A forward step tweens the fill; going backward retracts it without motion.

dashed.description: Draw the unfilled track dashed. The fill stays solid.

orient.description: A one-value prop: `horizontal` is the only value, and there is no vertical timeline. Setting it changes nothing (the component never reads it), so leave it out; any other value is a validate error.

current.description: The id of one stop to emphasise: a larger circle and a bold label. An unknown id is an error.
